title: Does probe accuracy track steering effectiveness concept-by-concept?

original_idea.body: Across 6-8 safety concepts, measure probe AUC (read) and steering effectiveness (write) from the same direction; plot read-vs-write per concept and identify divergences.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: read/write divergence map guides tool choice, but link skips a step.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Probe AUC + steering efficacy across concepts; clear inherited methodology.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused comparison across 6-8 concepts with held-out evals.

novelty.reasoning: Read/write coupling rarely measured directly; likely partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Per-concept detectability-vs-controllability mapping may be largely unmeasured.
